title: Wood iron structures

# Wood iron structures

# Introduction

Wood iron structures require wood and iron and the proximity of a forge to be built and repaired.

## Common properties

Wood iron structures share the following properties:

• Property: Durability | Value: 2000

• Property: Support | Value: Iron (from 20 to 1500)

• Property: Loss | Value: 1/13 vertical, 1/13 horizontal

• Property: Resistances | Value: Weak: Chop Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pickaxe, Fire, Frost, Lightning Resistant: Pierce Immune: Poison, Spirit

### Poles and beams

• Structure: Wood iron beam | Materials: Wood x2 Iron x1 | Size: 0x2x0 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Wood iron pole | Materials: Wood x2 Iron x1 | Size: 0x0x2 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Wood iron beam 45° | Materials: Wood x2 Iron x1 | Size: 0x2x2 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Wood iron beam 26° | Materials: Wood x2 Iron x1 | Size: 0x2x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes
